Lesson 28 — Understanding CAM Charges and Reconciliations. If you own, manage, or invest in commercial property in Chester County or Montgomery County, PA, accurate CAM accounting protects revenue, reduces disputes, and preserves tenant relationships. CAM reconciliations compare estimated collections to actual shared expenses and produce refunds or invoices for differences. This lesson explains common inclusions and exclusions, the reconciliation process, documentation best practices, and tenant communication. Practical steps include keeping organized invoices, defining CAM items clearly in leases, delivering timely reconciliations, and documenting adjustments. I can review your lease language, sample reconciliations, and tenant notices tailored to local properties. Want a focused review or help implementing clearer CAM practices? Visit dmsellscre.com/investors or DM me with CAM questions to get started.
